subject.title: fix(tui): deduplicate assistant messages across sessions.changed reload

question: Should this PR's runId surrender contract be accepted for TUI `sessions.changed` reloads, including suppressing late finals for finalized surrendered runs while allowing displayable finals for in-flight surrendered runs?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it changes cross-reload message/session-state behavior where maintainers must own the duplicate-versus-missing-message tradeoff.

options.title: Accept the current contract
options.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers agree that finalized surrendered runs should suppress late finals and in-flight surrendered runs may still render displayable finals.

options.title: Ask for native Telegram proof first
options.body: Pause merge until Mantis or a contributor recording shows the reported Telegram-to-TUI race leaves exactly one visible assistant reply.

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Ask for a revision if maintainers want a different rule for finalized runs, reset events, or long-delayed chat events after reload.

recommendation.title: Accept the current contract
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers agree that finalized surrendered runs should suppress late finals and in-flight surrendered runs may still render displayable finals.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is already assigned to `steipete`, so he is the clearest current owner for the merge-risk acceptance decision.
